description: Defines iterator classes (`ValidIterator`, `SentinelIterator`, and `Iterator`) for data loading in PyTorch, including iterator logic, comparison, and batch retrieval.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: A generic iterator class for batches, wrapping implementation details.

classes.name: ValidIterator
classes.description: Iterator that yields data batches until exhausted.

classes.name: SentinelIterator
classes.description: Iterator representing the end of data, always compares equal to exhausted ValidIterator.

classes.name: IteratorImpl
classes.description: Base class for iterator implementations, enabling double dispatch for comparisons.

methods.name: operator++
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next batch.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereferences the iterator to access the current batch.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Provides pointer access to the current batch.
